:::{#exm-essential-supremum-norm}
#### The essential supremum norm ignores a null set

Let $S = [0, 1]$ with the [Lebesgue measure](#def-lebesgue-measure) $\measure$.
Let $f(s) = 5$ if $s = 0$ and $f(s) = s$ otherwise.
Then $\sup_s \abs{f(s)} = 5$.
For $C \ge 1$, the [set](sets.qmd#def-set) $\set{s : \abs{f(s)} > C}$ is empty or $\set{0}$,
so it has [measure zero](#def-measure-zero),
and for $C < 1$ it has positive [measure](#def-measure).
By @def-essential-supremum-norm, $\norm{f}_\infty = 1$.

:::
